summary: ITERATION 17 (Canon v1.4) — BACKEND: 14/14 new live E2E tests passing + 27/27 canon unit tests green (total 41). Verified: canon VERSION 1.4 via /canon/validation, /canon/static returns full v1.4 unit catalog with exact rebalanced power/command (infantry 37/1, archer 40/1, cavalry 129/3, catapult 414/8, conquest_wagon 655/12, wolf 106/2, falcon 109/2, bear 212/4, lion 218/4, war_elephant 558/10, dragon 1740/25, angel 1810/25, demon 1880/25). Enemy curve exact: stage 1 = 75 (normal), boss stages 50/100/150/180/200 = 1092/9633/84586/310807/739513. /army/suggest?stage=200 on granted qa.bot3 account: picks correctly sorted by per_command desc, angel(20) + dragon(40) fully consumed, formation types <= slots (3/8 in test), command_used > 0, army_power ~382,600. PUT /army/formation applied cleanly (profile.combat.army_power reflected). Recruit endpoint (POST /army/recruit {unit,quantity}) working. Battle attempt/claim regression OK on stage 1. Rulebook PDF returns 200 application/pdf ~281KB, 41 pages, encrypted with empty password; extracted text contains 'v1.4' string. FRONTEND (390x844, qa.lord@example.com): Army tab shows Fanteria 37 and Drago 1740 power values; formation flow works end-to-end (formation-screen → suggest-formation-button → suggestion-panel showing 'Consiglio per lo stage 81' with Cavalleria×10 / Arciere×20 / Fanteria×22 at power 3547 and command 72/2490 → apply-suggestion-button applies and formation-power updates from 3454 to 3547). Battle tab renders lord-hp-bar + chat-dock. Profile tab exposes rules-pdf-button. No red-screen errors, no page crashes; only benign deprecation warnings from RN Web (pointerEvents/tintColor/textShadow/shadow style props) and Reanimated layout warning.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web deprecation warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: multiple RN components across the app (not blocking).
Deprecation: 'Image: style.tintColor is deprecated. Please use props.tintColor.' Non-blocking.
Deprecation: use style.textShadow / boxShadow shortcuts instead of the split props. Non-blocking.

'[Reanimated] Property [opacity] may be overwritten by a layout animation. Please wrap your component with an animated view and apply the layout animation on the wrapper.' Non-blocking cosmetic warning.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Address RN Web deprecation warnings in a future pass: replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents, migrate Image style.tintColor → props.tintColor, and consolidate textShadow*/shadow* into their shortcuts.
